content.title: Happy 29th Birthday, Hailey Bieber! See Her and Justin Bieber's Most Adorable Photos of Their Son Jack Blues
content.text: The Rhode founder, who turns 29 on Nov. 22, 2025, welcomed her son with the pop star in August 2024 Published on November 22, 2025 06:00AM EST Hailey Bieber and Jack Blues; Justin Bieber and Jack Blues. Credit : Hailey Bieber/Instagram; Justin Bieber/Instagram Justin and Hailey Bieber are proud parents to their baby boy Jack Blues. The couple, who married in September 2018, welcomed their son on August 22, 2024. Throughout their first year as parents, they've shared glimpses into their life with Jack — but making sure to keep his face out of the public eye until he "can understand it and it’s possible to have conversation around it," the Rhode founder explained to WSJ. Magazine. "I like who I am so much more now than I did before I had my son,” Hailey, who turns 29 on Nov. 22, 2025, added. "You gain this silent strength and confidence. You can’t tell me the same s--- that you could tell me before. You’re not f------ with me after I pushed a human out of my body.” Ahead, see the cutest photos that Justin and Hailey have posted of Jack Blues. Welcome to the World Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/ Instagram The first photo Justin shared of Jack featured his wife's hand and his newborn son's foot with the caption, "WELCOME HOME." Bright Spot Hailey Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Hailey Bieber/ Instagram Life changed a lot for Hailey in a year! On Easter, the model posted a photo holding Jack and compared it to her pregnant selfie from the year prior. Lounging Around Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/ Instagram In a rare look inside the Bieber household, the singer lounged with his mini-me. Going Green Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram In a carousel of photos celebrating his 31st birthday, the pop star included a smiley photo of himself holding his son. Crawling Home Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/ Instagram Justin doesn't shy away from showing love to his son on social media. How Knit Hailey Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Hailey Bieber/ Instagram Neither does Hailey, as evidenced by this sunny photo. Tats and Plaids Jack Blues Bieber and Justin Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram Justin declared it's "gonna be a good summer" with his son (and his two new albums SWAG and SWAG II), Dearest Dad Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram The father and son looked perfectly in sync in a sweet set of pictures. Start 'Em Early Jack Blues and Justin Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram Jack might take after his dad's musical prowess! Out of the Box Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram Justin knows that Jack is the total package. Making Waves Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram Leave it to the child of a model to have his own impressive accessory collection, like this gold bracelet with his initials. Ice Prince Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram Justin introduced his son to the world of hockey, dressing him up in merch from his home team, the Toronto Maple Leafs. Baby Blues Jack Blues Bieber. Hailey Bieber/Instagram Hailey encourages him to be sporty, too, sharing an adorable photo of Jack on the soccer pitch. Studio Session Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram A week before the release of SWAG, Justin let Jack give input in the studio. Photographic Memory Hailey Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Hailey Bieber/Instagram To celebrate Jack's first birthday, Hailey hosted a camp-themed party complete with a vintage photo booth. BOAT (Best of All Time) Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/ Instagram The 12-month-old and his dad took a canoe out for a family trip to the lake.
